name: caller-principal-python-session-stop-refuses-an-absent-principal
description: KTD12 -- the require-class half on Python. session-stop releases every grant the named session holds. The preflight CLAIMS session A, so A is bound; a request naming A without A's principal is then refused: HTTP 400 naming the header, with the typed reason a client classifies by equality, never a hold (KTD9). (A session nobody claimed -- an older client's -- is admitted instead: fixture 15 and warn_mode/05.) Twin of the Node row that sends the SAME claim and the SAME request and admits it (04). The claim captures nothing: 04 runs it against Node, which answers 404 and has no principal to capture. Enforcement is accident-resistance under the same-OS-user cooperative trust model, not caller separation: on the hook surface the principal is stored under .coherence/.

body.error: missing Coherence-Caller-Principal header: this route requires the caller principal that POST /principal/claim bound to the session_id it names (caller_principal_absent)
